output.title: Upgrading from Free to Pro plan
output.content: Upgrade from Account Settings > Billing > Change Plan. The Pro plan is billed immediately on a prorated basis for the remainder of your current billing cycle, then at the full rate from the next cycle onward.

output.title: API rate limits
output.content: The API allows 100 requests per minute on the Free and Pro plans, and 1000 requests per minute on the Enterprise plan. Exceeding the limit returns an HTTP 429 response with a Retry-After header.

output.title: Refund policy — duplicate charges
output.content: Duplicate charges caused by a billing system error are refunded automatically within 5 business days. No ticket is required, but you're welcome to ask support to confirm a specific refund is in progress.

output.content: To change the email address that receives invoices, go to Account Settings > Billing > Billing Contact and update the email field. This does not change your login email.

steps.rawOutput:
Great! I found the relevant information. Here's my reply:

---

**Subject: Re: Question about upgrading to Pro**

Thanks for asking! When you upgrade from Free to Pro, the charge is **prorated** for the remainder of your current billing cycle. This means you'll be charged a reduced amount right away based on how many days are left in your billing period. Then, starting with your next billing cycle, you'll be charged the full Pro plan rate.

You can make the upgrade anytime from **Account Settings > Billing > Change Plan**.

Let me know if you have any other questions!
